items.name: North Carolina Championship 2020

venue.name: NC State Fairgrounds
venue.address: 1025 Blue Ridge Rd, Raleigh, North Carolina 27607

items.information: # The competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. This competition is the State Championship for North Carolina, USA. Winners in each event from North Carolina will receive an award and the title of North Carolina State Champion. Every competitor **must** read the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthCarolinaChampionship2020#14226-competitor-information) Tab prior to registering. To help limit crowding we ask that competitors only bring one (and at most two) guests with them to the competition. Please always include your **name** and competition name in any email that you send to us. Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made via the email address you provided when you set up your WCA account. Registrations have to be approved *manually.* Please allow up to 48 hrs for your name to appear on the competitor's list. **If you are competing in Multi-Blind you must submit your cubes at 4:40pm on Saturday.**

items.name: Veenendaal Open 2020
items.information: De eerste 1,5 meter wedstrijd in Nederland! Let op: er is slechts een beperkt aantal plekken en er gelden aangepaste regels. Maximaal 1 begeleider per deelnemer (van te voren aanmelden via het betaalformulier). ____ The first 1,5 meter competition in the Netherlands! Please note: there are only a limited number of spots available and there are modified rules. Max. 1 companion per competitor (register in advance via the payment form).
